OnBehalfOf._ClientSecret_note: SECRET — do not commit a real value here. Override from env (OnBehalfOf__ClientSecret), Key Vault/Secrets Manager, or user-secrets.
OnBehalfOf._PrivateKeyJwt_note: Set ClientAuthentication=PrivateKeyJwt to use a signed assertion instead of a secret. SigningKeyPem is the SECRET private key (override from env/Key Vault/user-secrets); register the matching PUBLIC key with the provider.
